overview: Medicine in India is far broader than MBBS. Roughly 1.1M students take NEET UG annually for ~110,000 MBBS seats; the rest get filtered into BDS, AYUSH, nursing, and allied health — many of which are excellent careers but treated as 'consolation' paths. The 2026 reality: allied health (Audiology, Optometry, Perfusion, Speech-Language Pathology) often has better job security and faster entry to abroad work than mid-tier MBBS routes. Government MBBS fees stay between 7,000 and 6 lakh total; private medical colleges range up to 1 crore for the full degree — which has created a brutal financial barrier and pushed thousands toward MBBS abroad (Russia, Georgia, Philippines, Kazakhstan). Pharmacy, Nursing and Physiotherapy are now post-2025 NEET-mandatory in many states, raising entry standards.
key_insights: Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology have a working professional shortage of roughly 95% in India — fewer than 5,000 SLPs serve a population of ~50M with communication disorders.
BSc Perfusion Technology, Cardiac Care Technology, and Operation Theatre Technology pay 4-12 LPA fresh in metro corporate hospitals — almost nobody knows these exist after 12th.
MBBS abroad (Russia, Kazakhstan) total cost 25-40 lakh — the same as a private MBBS in India tier-2 — but FMGE/NExT pass rates are still under 30%, so it is not a guaranteed bypass.
BAMS and BHMS graduates can prescribe allopathy in some states' rural areas after bridge courses — practical scope is wider than the formal degree suggests.

Veterinary Science graduates from TANUVAS, IVRI, or GADVASU have near-100% placement in govt extension services, breeders, dairy/poultry industry — vastly under-applied vs the 1L+ NEET-UG seats it competes with.

sub_paths.name: MBBS (Medicine)
sub_paths.description: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery — the standard allopathic medicine degree leading to clinical practice or PG specialization.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: 50% PCB (General); 40% reserved categories; NEET cutoff dominant
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NEET UG (May 3, 2026)
sub_paths.govt_fees: AIIMS ~7,000 total; central govt colleges 2-6 lakh; state govt 50,000-3 lakh total
sub_paths.private_fees: 60 lakh to 1.2 Cr (deemed universities, private colleges)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: USMLE for USA (₹5-8L exam + residency match); PLAB/UKMLA for UK; AMC for Australia. PG abroad route 4-7 years post-MBBS. Common to do PG in India then move.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Long hospital hours (12-18 hrs in clinical years); ward rounds, emergencies, surgeries; intern stipend ₹15-30K/month govt.
sub_paths.growth_path: Intern to JR (PG) to SR to Asst Prof to Asso Prof to Prof / Consultant. PG (NEET PG via NExT from 2026) determines specialization. Private practice possible post-MD/MS.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher (post-internship, MBBS only): 3-8 LPA / Mid (post-PG MD/MS): 12-30 LPA / Senior consultant: 30 LPA-3 Cr+. Note: Private clinic/super-specialist 50L-2Cr; govt MO 7-10L. Source: AmbitionBox, hospital chain disclosures.

sub_paths.name: BDS (Dentistry)
sub_paths.description: Bachelor of Dental Surgery — clinical dentistry covering oral surgery, prosthodontics, orthodontics, and general dental practice.
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NEET UG
top_institutions: Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences Delhi (govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: DDS in USA (NBDE Part 1+2, ₹40-70L), Australia (ADC exam), UK (ORE). Saudi Arabia, UAE direct license recognition for BDS.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Clinic hours, patient procedures, lab work for prosthodontics. Pre-clinical years are heavy lab simulation work.
sub_paths.growth_path: BDS to MDS (PG) to consultant; or open private practice. Govt dental officer route via state PSCs at ₹8-12L. MDS specialists earn substantially more.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher (BDS only): 2.5-5 LPA / Mid (MDS): 8-20 LPA / Senior (private practice): 15-50 LPA. Note: BDS-only practice in metros saturated; MDS or specialty needed for higher pay. Source: AmbitionBox, Dental Council disclosures.

sub_paths.name: BAMS (Ayurveda)
sub_paths.description: Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery — the formal Ayurveda doctor degree under AYUSH ministry.
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NEET UG
top_institutions: All India Institute of Ayurveda Delhi (govt)
Rajiv Gandhi Univ of Health Sciences (govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Recognized in Nepal, Bhutan, Sri Lanka. Increasing demand in Germany, USA wellness sectors as Ayurvedic practitioner (separate certification needed).
sub_paths.day_in_life: Clinical OPD, panchakarma therapies, herbal medicine prep. Govt Ayurveda dispensaries 9-5; private clinic flexible.
sub_paths.growth_path: BAMS to MD Ayurveda (PG via AIAPGET) to Ayurveda specialist or to Wellness Resort consultant. Govt Ayush Medical Officer ₹8-12L start.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2-5 LPA / Mid (MD Ayurveda): 6-12 LPA / Senior: 12-30 LPA. Note: Wellness/spa industry (Patanjali, Himalaya, AyurUniverse) paying premium; rural BAMS practice ₹3-5L. Source: NCS, AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: BHMS (Homeopathy)
sub_paths.description: Bachelor of Homeopathic Medicine and Surgery — homeopathy practitioner degree.
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NEET UG
top_institutions: Bakson Homeopathic Medical College Greater Noida (private)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Recognized in UK, Germany, Switzerland with additional licensing. Strong scope in Europe wellness sector.
sub_paths.day_in_life: OPD-heavy, case-history intensive (homeopathy emphasizes detailed patient history). Mostly out-patient clinical.
sub_paths.growth_path: BHMS to MD Homeo (PG) to consultant or private clinic. Govt Homoeopathic Medical Officer 8-12L.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2-4 LPA / Mid: 5-10 LPA / Senior: 10-25 LPA. Note: Private practice variable; established homeopaths in metros 15-30L. Source: NCS, practitioner data.

sub_paths.name: BUMS (Unani Medicine)
sub_paths.description: Bachelor of Unani Medicine and Surgery — Unani system practitioner under AYUSH.
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NEET UG
top_institutions: National Institute of Unani Medicine Bangalore (govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Limited recognition; demand in Middle East wellness/clinical roles.
sub_paths.day_in_life: OPD clinical work in Unani dispensaries; herbal medicine preparation.
sub_paths.growth_path: BUMS to MD Unani to Govt Medical Officer Unani or private practice.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2-4 LPA / Mid: 5-9 LPA / Senior: 10-20 LPA. Note: Smaller practitioner pool but stable govt jobs in NE India and Telangana. Source: NCS, AYUSH ministry.

sub_paths.name: Veterinary Science (BVSc & AH)
sub_paths.description: Bachelor of Veterinary Science & Animal Husbandry — animal medicine, surgery, public health, dairy/livestock production.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: 50% PCB; NEET applies for 15% AIQ veterinary seats
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NEET UG
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MS/PhD — USA (Cornell, UC Davis, Texas A&M), UK (Royal Veterinary College), Australia (Murdoch). Direct vet license practice possible in Australia, UAE.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Mix of clinical OPD (small/large animal), farm visits, govt extension work. Private vet clinics increasingly metro-based for pets.
sub_paths.growth_path: Veterinary Officer (state PSC) ₹10-15L start, to Asst Director, to Director. Private pet clinic chain (Cessna, ThePetNest), pharma R&D, dairy/poultry corporate roles. UPSC IFS-Indian Forest Service open.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 4-8 LPA / Mid: 8-16 LPA / Senior: 16-40 LPA. Note: Govt vet officer 10-12L start; private pet practice growing fast in metros. Source: NCS, AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: BPT (Physiotherapy)
sub_paths.description: Bachelor of Physiotherapy — rehabilitation, sports medicine, neurological/orthopedic recovery using exercise and manual therapy.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: 50% PCB (some accept PCM); NEET mandatory in many states from 2025
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NEET UG (mandatory in most states from 2025), state CETs, IPU CET, university entrances
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Direct license possible in Australia (APC), Canada (PCE), UAE/Gulf with HAAD/DHA. UK requires HCPC registration. MS/MPT in USA/UK/Australia 25-50 lakh.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Patient sessions in clinic/hospital, exercise therapy, manual therapy, electrotherapy. Sports-team physios travel with teams.
sub_paths.growth_path: Physiotherapist to Senior to Clinic Director or specialty (sports, neuro, ortho, geriatric). MPT (PG) for academic/specialist roles.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2.5-5 LPA / Mid: 5-12 LPA / Senior: 10-25 LPA. Note: Sports physio/private clinics 8-15L; UAE/Australia license 30-60L. Source: AmbitionBox, NCS.

sub_paths.name: BSc Nursing
sub_paths.description: 4-year Bachelor of Nursing — clinical nursing, ICU/critical care, community health, hospital management.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: 50% PCB; NEET UG mandatory for BSc Nursing from 2023
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NEET UG; AIIMS BSc Nursing exam
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Massive demand — USA (NCLEX-RN), UK (NMC OSCE), Canada (NCLEX-RN), Australia (AHPRA), Germany (Pflegekraft program), Gulf (DHA/HAAD/Prometric). Pay 30-80 lakh/year.
sub_paths.day_in_life: 12-hr hospital shifts, ward management, IV/medication, patient monitoring, doctor-patient liaison. Stressful but high impact.
sub_paths.growth_path: Staff Nurse to Senior to Ward Sister to Nursing Superintendent. MSc Nursing for academic/specialist roles. Govt staff nurse ₹6-9L start.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2.5-5 LPA / Mid: 5-10 LPA / Senior: 10-25 LPA. Note: Abroad pay vastly higher — UK staff nurse £28-35K (~30-37L INR); USA RN $75-95K (~62-80L). Source: AmbitionBox, NCS, NMC UK.

sub_paths.name: Optometry (B.Optom / BSc Optometry)
sub_paths.description: Eye care, vision testing, contact lens fitting, low-vision rehabilitation, vision therapy.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: 50-55% PCB or PCM in some institutes
sub_paths.duration: 4 years (3.5 + 6 mo internship) or 3-year BSc Optometry
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NEET UG (for some govt institutes); institute entrance exams (LV Prasad, AIIMS Optom)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Optometrist license — Australia (OBA), Canada (CAOO), UK (GOC). USA requires OD (Doctor of Optometry, 4 yrs after BSc). UAE accepts B.Optom directly.
sub_paths.day_in_life: OPD eye exams, contact lens fitting, low-vision evaluation, vision therapy sessions in eye hospitals or chains (Lenskart, Titan Eye+).
sub_paths.growth_path: Optometrist to Clinical Specialist to Practice owner; or corporate optical chains (Lenskart, Vision Express) to mgmt; M.Optom for academic.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2.5-5 LPA / Mid: 5-12 LPA / Senior: 10-25 LPA. Note: Lenskart/corporate chains 4-8L start; specialty hospitals (LVPEI) 6-10L; abroad 30-60L. Source: AmbitionBox, NCS.

sub_paths.name: Audiology & Speech-Language Pathology (BASLP)
sub_paths.description: Diagnose and treat hearing, speech, language, swallowing disorders. Severe shortage of professionals in India.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: 50% PCB (PCM accepted at some institutes); NEET in some states
sub_paths.entrance_exam: AIISH entrance, IPU CET, NEET UG (some), institute exams
sub_paths.govt_fees: AIISH Mysore 25,000-50,000 total (with stipend!); govt colleges 1-2 lakh
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Master's required in USA (MS-SLP, ~₹40-60L); Australia (Speech Pathology Australia), Canada (SAC), UK (RCSLT), Gulf (HAAD/DHA). Massive shortage worldwide.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Diagnostic audiology testing, hearing aid fitting, speech therapy sessions, pediatric/geriatric/stroke rehabilitation. Hospital + private clinic mix.
sub_paths.growth_path: Audiologist/SLP to Senior to Clinic Director or Hospital head; MASLP for advanced practice; govt audiologist ₹8-12L. Private pediatric speech clinics highly profitable.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 3-6 LPA / Mid: 6-15 LPA / Senior: 12-35 LPA. Note: Indian audiologist ceiling 50K-1L/month; UAE/USA SLP $60-90K (~50-75L). Genuine demand-supply gap. Source: AmbitionBox, AIISH disclosures.

sub_paths.name: BSc Radiology / Radiography
sub_paths.description: Medical imaging — X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, mammography. Operates imaging equipment, supports radiologists.
sub_paths.qualification: BSc Medical Imaging Tech / Radiography / Radiology Tech
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NEET UG (some), state CETs, institute entrance
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: USA (ARRT certification), Australia (MRPBA), Canada (CAMRT), UAE/Gulf (DHA/HAAD). Strong demand in radiology imaging globally.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Equipment operation, patient positioning, image quality checks, radiation safety. Diagnostic centres, hospital imaging departments.
sub_paths.growth_path: Radiographer to Senior to Imaging Tech Lead. Govt hospital tech ₹5-8L; corporate diagnostic chains 4-8L. PG MSc enables academic/specialty roles.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2.5-5 LPA / Mid: 5-10 LPA / Senior: 10-22 LPA. Note: Apollo, Fortis, Max imaging 5-8L; abroad 35-50L. Source: AmbitionBox, NCS.

sub_paths.name: Occupational Therapy (BOT)
sub_paths.description: Help patients regain function in daily living after injury, stroke, developmental disorders, mental health conditions.
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NEET UG (most states), state CETs, institute entrance
top_institutions: Pt. Deendayal Upadhyaya National Institute Mumbai (govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: USA (NBCOT), Australia (AHPRA), Canada (CAOT), UK (HCPC). Massive shortage in Australia, USA — strong migration pathway.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Patient sessions in rehab centres, hospitals, schools (pediatric OT), psychiatric units. Custom adaptive equipment, ADL training.
sub_paths.growth_path: OT to Senior to Specialist (peds, neuro, mental health) to Clinic Director. MOT for academic/specialty.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2.5-5 LPA / Mid: 5-12 LPA / Senior: 10-22 LPA. Note: Australia OT $70-90K (~45-58L); USA $80K+. Indian rehab clinics 4-8L. Source: AmbitionBox, NCS.

sub_paths.name: Paramedical (BSc Paramedical / DMLT diploma)
sub_paths.description: Umbrella term for emergency med tech, dialysis tech, anesthesia tech, OT tech, cardiac care tech, EMT roles.
sub_paths.qualification: BSc Paramedical / Diploma in Medical Lab Tech (DMLT) / Cardiac/OT Tech
sub_paths.entrance_exam: State paramedical CETs, NEET UG (some), institute entrance
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Limited; Gulf (DHA/HAAD) accepts paramedical certifications. Australia EMT pathway through bridge programs.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Hospital ward/lab/OT support work, emergency response, sample collection, equipment monitoring. High-volume, lower autonomy than nursing.
sub_paths.growth_path: Tech to Senior Tech to Tech Supervisor; pivot to nursing or BSc upgrade. Govt tech roles ₹4-7L start.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 1.8-3.5 LPA / Mid: 3-6 LPA / Senior: 6-12 LPA. Note: Govt hosp ₹4-6L; corporate chains 3-5L; abroad Gulf 8-15L. Source: NCS, AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Medical Lab Technology (BMLT / DMLT)
sub_paths.description: Pathology lab work — blood/urine/tissue analysis, microbiology, biochemistry, hematology.
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NEET UG (BMLT in some states), state CETs, institute entrance
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: USA (ASCP cert), UK (HCPC), Canada (CSMLS), Gulf (DHA/HAAD). Strong migration for BMLT graduates.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Lab-based — sample processing, instrument operation (auto-analyzers), reporting. Diagnostic chains (Dr. Lal, Metropolis) or hospital labs.
sub_paths.growth_path: Lab Tech to Senior Tech to Lab Supervisor to Lab Manager. MSc MLT for specialist/academic. Govt lab tech 5-8L.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2-4 LPA / Mid: 4-9 LPA / Senior: 9-18 LPA. Note: Dr. Lal/Metropolis 3-6L; AIIMS lab tech 6-10L; abroad 30-50L. Source: AmbitionBox, NCS.

sub_paths.name: Pharmacy (B.Pharm / D.Pharm / Pharm.D)
sub_paths.description: Drug formulation, retail pharmacy, hospital pharmacy, clinical pharmacy (Pharm.D), pharmaceutical industry.
sub_paths.qualification: B.Pharm (4 yr) / D.Pharm (2 yr) / Pharm.D (6 yr)
sub_paths.entrance_exam: GPAT (PG), NEET (some), state CETs, BITSAT, university entrances
sub_paths.govt_fees: B.Pharm: 50,000-2 lakh total (govt); Pharm.D: 1-3 lakh govt
sub_paths.private_fees: B.Pharm 2-8 lakh; Pharm.D 6-15 lakh; Manipal/SRM higher
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: USA (FPGEE + NAPLEX), UK (GPhC), Canada (PEBC), Australia (APC). Pharm.D graduates can work as clinical pharmacists in US/Gulf.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Industry: formulation, QA/QC, regulatory affairs in pharma cos (Sun Pharma, Cipla, Dr. Reddy's). Retail/hospital pharmacy: dispensing, counseling.
sub_paths.growth_path: Pharma Industry: Officer to Manager to GM to VP. Pharm.D: Clinical Pharmacist to Senior to Director. Retail: store mgr to pharmacy chain ops.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2.5-7 LPA / Mid: 7-18 LPA / Senior: 18-50 LPA. Note: Pharma R&D at MNCs 8-15L; retail pharmacist 3-5L; Pharm.D abroad 50L+. Source: AmbitionBox, NIPER placement.

sub_paths.name: Prosthetics & Orthotics (BPO)
sub_paths.description: Design and fit artificial limbs, braces, supportive devices for amputees, polio survivors, spine/joint patients.
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NEET UG (some), institute entrance (NIEPMD, NILD)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: USA (ABC certification), Germany strong (Otto Bock partnerships), UK (BAPO). Demand exists globally; small profession means slow hiring cycles.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Patient measurements, custom device design, lab fabrication, fitting sessions. Mostly rehab centres, ALIMCO, NGO sector (Jaipur Foot/BMVSS).
sub_paths.growth_path: Prosthetist/Orthotist to Senior to Centre Director. Pure clinical roles + few R&D openings at Otto Bock India, Ottobock partners.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2.5-5 LPA / Mid: 5-12 LPA / Senior: 10-22 LPA. Note: ALIMCO/govt rehab ₹6-9L; private fitting clinics variable; NGO sector lower. Source: NCS, RCI registry.

sub_paths.name: Perfusion Technology (BSc CPCT)
sub_paths.description: Operate heart-lung machines during open-heart surgery; cardiopulmonary bypass technician — niche, high-demand role.
sub_paths.qualification: BSc Cardiac Perfusion / Cardiopulmonary Care Tech
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NEET UG (some), institute entrance
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: USA (ABCP certification, MS in Perfusion), UK (Society of Clinical Perfusion Scientists). High pay overseas; very small profession.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Operate heart-lung machine (CPB) during cardiac surgery — extremely high-stakes, requires deep teamwork with cardiac surgeon. Long OT shifts.
sub_paths.growth_path: Junior Perfusionist to Senior to Chief Perfusionist; specialty in pediatric or transplant. Tied closely to cardiac surgical centres.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 4-8 LPA / Mid: 8-15 LPA / Senior: 15-30 LPA. Note: Strong demand at Apollo, Narayana, Fortis, AIIMS — perfusionists are hospital-critical. USA $90-120K. Source: AmbitionBox, hospital disclosures.

sub_paths.name: Cytogenetics / Medical Genetics (BSc / MSc)
sub_paths.description: Chromosomal analysis, prenatal diagnosis, genetic counseling, rare disease genetics — emerging field with India lacking trained workforce.
sub_paths.qualification: BSc Genetics / MSc Medical Genetics / Genetic Counsellor cert
sub_paths.entrance_exam: CUET UG, IIT JAM (MSc), university entrances
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MS Medical Genetics — USA (Johns Hopkins, Sarah Lawrence ~₹40-60L for MS in Genetic Counseling), UK (Manchester, Cambridge), Canada (UBC). Massive shortage of genetic counsellors in USA/Australia.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Lab work (karyotyping, FISH, NGS analysis) or counseling sessions for genetic risk. Diagnostic labs (MedGenome, Strand Life Sciences) or hospital genetics depts.
sub_paths.growth_path: Cytogeneticist/Genetic Counselor to Senior to Lab Director. Strong rare-disease and prenatal-diagnostics market growth.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher (BSc): 3-6 LPA / Mid (MSc): 6-15 LPA / Senior: 15-35 LPA. Note: MedGenome, Strand, MapmyGenome 6-12L; abroad genetic counselor $70-95K. Source: AmbitionBox, BiotechFront.

sub_paths.name: BSc Operation Theatre Technology / Anesthesia Tech
sub_paths.description: Sterile prep, surgical instrument handling, anesthesia equipment monitoring, post-op care — direct OT support roles.
sub_paths.qualification: BSc OT Tech / Anesthesia Tech / DOTT
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NEET UG (some), state CETs, institute entrance
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Limited direct license; Gulf (DHA/HAAD) accepts. UK/Australia OT tech requires bridge training.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Pre-op sterile prep, OT during surgery (instrument handling), post-op recovery support. Long shifts in metro corporate hospitals.
sub_paths.growth_path: OT Tech to Senior to OT Supervisor to OT Manager. Strong demand in Apollo, Fortis, Max, AIIMS. BSc upgrade enables academic move.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2.5-4.5 LPA / Mid: 4.5-9 LPA / Senior: 9-18 LPA. Note: Corporate hospitals 3.5-6L; AIIMS OT tech 5-7L; Gulf 8-14L. Source: AmbitionBox, hospital data.

sub_paths.name: BSc Respiratory Care / Cardiac Care Technology
sub_paths.description: ICU respiratory therapy, ventilator management, pulmonary function tests, ECG/echo for cardiac diagnostics.
sub_paths.qualification: BSc Respiratory Therapy / Cardiac Care Tech
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NEET UG (some), state CETs, institute entrance
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: USA (NBRC for RT), Canada (CSRT), Gulf direct hiring. RT graduates get strong migration pathways with shortage roles in USA/Canada.
sub_paths.day_in_life: ICU/CCU work — managing ventilators, ABG analysis, ECG/echo for cardiac. High-acuity patient care.
sub_paths.growth_path: RT/Cardiac Tech to Senior to ICU Tech Lead. MSc enables academic. Strong post-COVID demand in tier-1 hospitals.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 3-6 LPA / Mid: 6-12 LPA / Senior: 12-25 LPA. Note: Apollo/Fortis/Max ICU RT 4-8L; AIIMS 6-9L; Gulf RT 12-25L; USA RT $65-85K. Source: AmbitionBox, NCS.

data_confidence_notes: MBBS, BDS, BSc Nursing, Pharmacy data verified via NMC, INC, NEET UG 2026 official sources.
AIISH stipend confirmed at ₹800/month for first 3 years from official AIISH PDF.
NEET UG 2026 confirmed for May 3, 2026; mandatory for MBBS, BDS, AYUSH (BAMS, BHMS, BUMS, BSMS), BVSc, BSc Nursing.
Niche roles (Perfusion, Cytogenetics, Prosthetics, OT Tech) flagged 'low' or 'medium' confidence — Indian salary data is sparse and varies enormously by hospital chain.
Audiology/SLP demand-supply gap is real and well-documented; salary range reflects current AmbitionBox data but ceiling may rise as the profession scales.
